name: Concerns Compliance Control
description: A finding concerns a compliance control it bears on — the control/requirement/indicator the finding was observed against. The relationship_type property classifies the verdict (passing, violation, informational, other). Regime-agnostic and free-floating: the target is a wildcard so a single finding can concern controls in FedRAMP (a ksi_indicator), SOC2, ISO 27001, or several regimes at once. The generic control supertype that would constrain the target is deferred until a second regime lands (compliance_core v0 non-goals); until then the target is open and consumers constrain it in their queries. Vocabulary aligns with HAS_COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE.support_kind.
